brand.indigo-500-note: Accessible companion for control boundaries (3.8:1 on white); Indigo 200 stays the brand tint for placeholder fills, not control outlines.

support.usage: Small badges, chips and labels only - never large surfaces, so they do not compete with the ink + indigo brand identity.
support.dangerTextUsage: Error helper text and small error labels (4.9:1 on white). Danger #FF5252 stays for borders and badges paired with ink text.

font.figuresUsage: Key UI numbers (estimated return, token value, round progress), Bold 700, slightly larger than surrounding text.

usage.lg: Asset cards (e.g. the Riverside Apartments card) and dropdown menus.
usage.xl: Modals and large interface contours (dashboard blocks).
usage.tile/block: Relative corner radii of the logo symbol itself; keep them proportional when scaling the mark or the funding grid.

spacing.rule: Only values from this scale for margins and inner spacing. Arbitrary values are not allowed.

grid.note: Flexible column system; side margins stay fixed at 24px on both breakpoints.

loadingPulse.use: while the platform refreshes live data from the Stellar network

motion.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion: no slide or pulse; state changes fade in 200ms and the dashed token stays at full opacity. See ui-kit/motion/token-fitting-spec.json.

primary.disabled: 40% opacity, cursor not-allowed (e.g. while verification/KYC is not approved)

input.normal: 1px solid #7376E8 (Indigo 500 - accessible control boundary, 3.8:1 on white). Indigo 200 #C7C8F9 stays the brand tint for placeholder fills, not control outlines.
input.error: 1.5px solid #FF5252 border; helper text in #D32F2F with an error icon and an explicit 'Error:' label (never color alone)

assetGrid.summary: 3x3 tile block for cards and quick summaries
assetGrid.detail: 10x10 matrix (100 tiles) on project detail pages; 1 tile = 1% funded
assetGrid.ratios: gap = tile / 4; inner padding = tile x 0.55; tile corner radius 22.5%; block corner radius 14.1%
assetGrid.fillOrder: bottom row first, left to right, then upward - the block fills up as the crowd funds it

chart.line: thin 2px Indigo (#4B4FE2) lines on clean Paper (#F6F6FE) backgrounds
chart.note: Yield/return charts are a future-state pattern for the production platform; the current testnet prototype records contributions only, with no real funds.
